title: Stort Chemicals Ltd
content:
Stort Chemicals is a United Kingdom specialty chemicals distributor serving manufacturers in coatings, construction, and industrial markets. The company acts as a channel partner for aerogel materials used in formulation-driven insulation and coating systems.

  • Coverage Area: United Kingdom and Ireland
  • Focus Areas: Aerogel powders for coatings, construction additives, raw materials for formulation, and thermal-insulation systems
  • Current Brands Represented: Svenska Aerogel (Quartzene®)
  • Official Website: https://stortchemicals.co.uk/
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
